skill.name: pitfalls-drizzle-orm
skill.description: Drizzle ORM patterns and migration safety rules. Use when defining schemas, running migrations, or debugging database issues. Triggers on: Drizzle, schema, migration, db:push, $inferSelect, array column.
skill.summary: Helps teams apply safer Drizzle ORM schema, type inference, validation, and migration patterns.
skill.author: BarisSozen

content.value_statement: Drizzle ORM schema mistakes can break migrations and weaken type safety. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code toward safer patterns.
actual_capabilities: Reviews Drizzle ORM schemas for risky primary key type changes.
Checks array column syntax against the documented text().array() pattern.
Prompts creation of insert and select types with Drizzle inference helpers.
Encourages drizzle-zod validation for insert and select schemas.
Provides a short checklist for migration review before production changes.
limitations: It does not inspect a live database or migration history by itself.
It cannot guarantee that db:push is safe for every production schema.
It focuses on common Drizzle ORM pitfalls, not full database architecture.
It depends on the user or agent to provide relevant schema context.

use_cases.title: Review a new Drizzle schema
use_cases.description: Check schema definitions for primary key changes, array syntax, and exported inferred types before merging.

use_cases.title: Prepare a migration safely
use_cases.description: Evaluate whether a planned migration may cause data loss and confirm safer testing steps first.

use_cases.title: Improve validation coverage
use_cases.description: Add or review drizzle-zod validation patterns that align with Drizzle insert and select schemas.

prompt_templates.title: Check a simple schema
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of one Drizzle table definition.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Drizzle ORM schema for common pitfalls. Check primary keys, array column syntax, inferred types, and validation gaps.

prompt_templates.title: Review migration readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess this planned Drizzle migration. Identify data-loss risks, primary key changes, and steps I should test before applying it.

prompt_templates.title: Add type inference and validation
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate implementation support for TypeScript projects.
prompt_templates.prompt: Update this Drizzle schema pattern to include select types, insert types, and drizzle-zod validation. Explain each change briefly.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a schema change set
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review across related schema and migration changes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit these Drizzle ORM schema changes as a release reviewer. Flag migration blockers, unsafe force-push risks, and missing validation contracts.

output_examples.input: A schema review request with an array column and missing inferred insert type.
output: Flags the incorrect array column pattern.
Recommends the Drizzle array helper style used by the skill.
Notes that insert and select types should be exported from the schema.

output_examples.input: A migration plan that changes a primary key from serial to uuid.
output: Marks the primary key type change as a migration blocker.
Explains that production data and references need a safer migration plan.
Suggests testing in development and preparing backups before any risky operation.

output_examples.input: A request to add validation around Drizzle inserts.
output: Connects validation types to the Drizzle table definition.
Keeps database and runtime validation contracts aligned.

best_practices: Review primary key type changes as release blockers unless a planned migration path exists.
Export inferred select and insert types beside each important Drizzle table definition.
Test migrations in development and review data-loss warnings before production deployment.
anti_patterns: Running forced schema pushes in production without a verified backup and rollback plan.
Using custom array helpers when Drizzle table columns support the documented array method.
Duplicating TypeScript model types by hand instead of inferring them from Drizzle schemas.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps agents review Drizzle ORM schema and migration work for common safety and type issues.

faq.question: Does it run database commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. It documents commands and review steps, but it does not execute commands by itself.

faq.question: Can it make production migrations safe by itself?
faq.answer: No. It provides review guidance, but production migrations still need testing, backups, and human approval.

faq.question: Why does it warn about primary key type changes?
faq.answer: Changing primary key types can break migrations, references, and existing data relationships.

faq.question: Which AI coding tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is this a full Drizzle ORM tutorial?
faq.answer: No. It is a focused checklist for recurring Drizzle ORM schema and migration pitfalls.
